A '''research station''' was established by [[Schenor]] colonists. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was [[Massacre at the Schenor research station|attacked]] by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] backed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Despite the efforts of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] team to assist, all the colonists, save for the juvenile [[A'kazz]], were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Silent" />
